evidence.quote: A fee equal to 20% of the class fund is a defensible request, subject to court approval;
Open with substantial automatic class relief, a separately paid fee proportionate to the fund, and no fee reversion.

evidence.agent: Hargrove Lane LLP declaration to court
evidence.quote: Fees were discussed from the first proposal, not only after class relief was agreed.

summary: Plaintiff-side counsel raised fees in the first round, and the settlement proposals negotiated fee amounts at the same time as class relief rather than only after relief was settled. The transcript expressly links fees to the fund through proportional fee requests. There is no clear evidence that plaintiffs sacrificed class recovery for fees, that defense leveraged fee interests, or that the declaration was misleading.
